name: SidePanel
purpose: A modal panel anchored to the right edge of the viewport, for a persistent secondary task alongside — but still blocking — the main page (details, a form, a filter builder).
neverUseFor: A quick, focused decision that should fully interrupt the page — use Modal instead
Non-blocking supplementary info — use Tooltip or Popover instead

authored.name: expanded
authored.description: Whether the panel is open. Same native <dialog> + JS-timed close choreography as Modal — see ADR-010.

anatomy.description: Native <dialog>, opened via showModal(), styled to the right or bottom edge (see `placement`) instead of centered — same primitive as Modal (ADR-010). No backdrop scrim (unlike Modal) — the page behind stays visible.
The panel's accessible name — referenced via aria-labelledby. Same text style as Modal's title.
An IconButton (IconX, size l) positioned top-right, calls onDismiss.

props.name: label
props.description: The panel's title — rendered visibly and used as its accessible name.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the panel is open. Always controlled, same reasoning as Modal.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the panel should close — the close (X) button, Escape, or a backdrop click.

props.name: showCloseButton
props.description: Whether to render the header's close (X) button.

props.name: closeOnBackdropClick
props.description: Whether clicking outside the panel dismisses it.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which edge of the viewport the panel is anchored to and slides from. Same vocabulary as Tooltip's `placement` — only the two edges that make sense for a full-height ('right') or full-width ('bottom') panel.

width.note: Fixed panel width, not on the shared size scale — same category of per-component literal as Tooltip's 240px max-width.

height.note: Full viewport height — anchored top-to-bottom against the right edge.

keyboardNav: Escape — dismisses (native <dialog> cancel event, redirected through onDismiss per ADR-010)
Tab — cycles focus, trapped inside the panel (native)
